name: MIT Sloan School of Management
description_en: MIT Sloan is known for its rigorous quantitative curriculum and close integration with MIT's science and engineering ecosystem. Its graduates go on to lead in technology, finance, consulting and operations, and the school is a centre of research in finance, economics and management science.
description_cn: 麻省理工斯隆管理学院以严谨的定量课程以及与 MIT 科学、工程生态的紧密结合著称，毕业生活跃在科技、金融、咨询和运营领域，学院也是金融、经济与管理科学研究的重镇。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Action-learning MBA with cross-functional labs and global immersion. Access MIT's full ecosystem.
programs_detail.description_cn: 行动学习型MBA，配备跨职能实验室和全球沉浸项目，充分融入MIT创新生态。

programs_detail.name: Master of Finance (MFin)
programs_detail.description_en: Quantitative finance degree targeting asset management, IBD, and risk roles.
programs_detail.description_cn: 定量金融硕士，面向资产管理、投资银行和风险管理职位。

programs_detail.name: Management of Technology (MOT)
programs_detail.description_en: For engineers and scientists moving into business leadership roles at tech companies.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向工程师和科学家向科技公司管理层转型而设计的专项项目。

name: Imperial College Business School
description_en: Imperial College Business School sits within one of the world's leading science and engineering universities, which shapes its strengths in finance, analytics and innovation. Its MSc Finance and other specialist masters are popular with students aiming for London's finance and fintech sectors.
description_cn: 帝国理工商学院依托全球顶尖的理工科大学，在金融、数据分析和创新方向优势明显；金融硕士等专业硕士项目深受希望进入伦敦金融与金融科技行业的学生欢迎。

programs_detail.name: MSc Finance
programs_detail.description_en: FT-ranked #1 Finance MSc in UK; deep quant curriculum for IBD, asset management, trading.
programs_detail.description_cn: 英国金融时报排名第一的金融硕士，深度量化课程，面向投行、资管和交易职位。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: 1-year MBA at world-leading science & engineering university with strong tech sector links.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全球顶尖理工大学的一年制MBA，与科技产业紧密联系。

programs_detail.name: MSc Accounting
programs_detail.description_en: Rigorous accounting master with strong Big 4 and financial services placement.
programs_detail.description_cn: 严格的会计硕士，在四大和金融服务行业的就业表现卓越。

programs_detail.name: MSc Innovation & Entrepreneurship
programs_detail.description_en: Startup-focused master embedded within Imperial's innovation ecosystem.
programs_detail.description_cn: 嵌入帝国理工创新生态系统的以初创企业为核心的硕士项目。

name: Graduate School of Business
description_en: Stanford GSB is the most selective business school in the world, accepting under 7% of MBA applicants. Located in the heart of Silicon Valley, it shapes the leaders of the world's most influential companies and social enterprises. Its culture of 'change lives, change organizations, change the world' attracts exceptional talent globally.
description_cn: 斯坦福商学院是全球录取率最低的商学院，MBA录取率不足7%。坐落于硅谷腹地，培养了全球最具影响力企业和社会企业的领导者。其「改变生活、改变组织、改变世界」的理念吸引了全球顶尖人才。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: The world's most selective MBA. Emphasizes personal leadership, with unrivalled Silicon Valley access.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全球最难录取的MBA项目，强调个人领导力，拥有无与伦比的硅谷资源。

programs_detail.name: MSx (Master of Science in Management)
programs_detail.description_en: Accelerated programme for mid-career leaders with 8+ years of experience.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向8年以上工作经验的中层管理者的加速项目。

programs_detail.name: PhD
programs_detail.description_en: Research doctorate across Accounting, Economics, Finance, Marketing, Operations, OB.
programs_detail.description_cn: 覆盖会计、经济、金融、市场、运营、组织行为的研究型博士项目。

alumni_detail.name: Vinod Khosla
alumni_detail.role: Co-founder, Sun Microsystems; founder, Khosla Ventures (MBA)

name: Saïd Business School
description_en: Oxford Saïd is built on the foundation of one of the world's oldest and most prestigious universities, founded in 1096. The unique 1+1 MBA allows students to combine the MBA with another Oxford Master's degree. Oxford's vast interdisciplinary resources in law, medicine, government, and policy make it exceptional for those seeking broader impact.
description_cn: 牛津赛德商学院依托创建于1096年的世界最古老最负盛名的大学。独特的1+1 MBA允许学生将MBA与牛津另一个硕士学位相结合。牛津在法律、医学、政府和政策领域无与伦比的跨学科资源，使其在追求更广泛影响力的学生中尤为出色。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Intensive 12-month Oxford MBA with unparalleled interdisciplinary access.
programs_detail.description_cn: 密集12个月牛津MBA，拥有无可比拟的跨学科资源。

programs_detail.name: 1+1 MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Combine the Oxford MBA with any other Oxford Master's degree (Law, Policy, Computer Science, etc.).
programs_detail.description_cn: 将牛津MBA与任何其他牛津硕士学位（法律、政策、计算机科学等）相结合。

programs_detail.name: MSc Financial Economics
programs_detail.description_en: Top-ranked Oxford economics master with deep financial modelling and econometrics.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全球顶尖的牛津经济学硕士，深入学习金融建模和计量经济学。

name: Harvard Business School
description_en: Harvard Business School, founded in 1908, pioneered the case method of teaching that business schools around the world now use. Its large alumni network and the Harvard brand make it a benchmark for general management education, and its Baker Library holds one of the world's largest business research collections.
description_cn: 哈佛商学院创立于 1908 年，开创了如今被全球商学院广泛采用的案例教学法。庞大的校友网络与哈佛品牌使其成为综合管理教育的标杆；贝克图书馆是全球最大的商业研究馆藏之一。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Case-method MBA with 500+ cases per year, creating decisive general managers.
programs_detail.description_cn: 每年超过500个案例的案例教学MBA，培养果断的通才管理者。

programs_detail.name: HBX CORe (online)
programs_detail.description_en: Online certificate in business fundamentals: analytics, economics, financial accounting.
programs_detail.description_cn: 在线商业基础证书：数据分析、经济学、财务会计。

programs_detail.name: Executive Education
programs_detail.description_en: World's top executive programmes for senior leaders across industries.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向各行业高级领导者的全球顶尖高管教育项目。

alumni_detail.name: Michael Bloomberg
alumni_detail.role: Founder, Bloomberg L.P.; former Mayor of New York City (MBA)

alumni_detail.name: Mitt Romney
alumni_detail.role: Former US Senator and Governor of Massachusetts (JD/MBA)

name: Judge Business School
description_en: Cambridge Judge is one of the fastest-rising business schools globally, leveraging Cambridge University's 800-year heritage and extraordinary research network. Its MFin (Master of Finance) programme is consistently ranked among Europe's best. Cambridge's ties to Silicon Fen, the UK's technology cluster, create exceptional tech and startup opportunities.
description_cn: 剑桥贾奇商学院是全球排名上升最快的商学院之一，依托剑桥大学800年的历史传承和卓越的研究网络。其金融硕士（MFin）项目持续跻身欧洲最佳之列。剑桥与英国科技产业集群「硅沼」的紧密联系为学生创造了非凡的科技和创业机遇。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Full-time 1-year MBA drawing on 800+ years of Cambridge tradition and Silicon Fen tech links.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全日制一年制MBA，依托剑桥800多年的历史传承和硅沼科技产业联系。

programs_detail.name: Master of Finance (MFin)
programs_detail.description_en: Europe's top-ranked finance master, consistently #1 in FT rankings.
programs_detail.description_cn: 欧洲顶尖金融硕士，持续荣获《金融时报》排名第一。

programs_detail.name: EMBA
programs_detail.description_en: Executive MBA for senior leaders combining Cambridge rigour with global peer network.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向高级领导者的高管MBA，融合剑桥严谨学术与全球同伴网络。

programs_detail.name: MPhil in Finance
programs_detail.description_en: Research-oriented pre-doctoral master in finance and financial economics.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向金融和金融经济学领域的科研型预博士硕士项目。

name: Department of Management, Technology and Economics
description_en: ETH Zurich's Department of Management, Technology and Economics (D-MTEC) brings management and economics teaching into one of the world's leading science and engineering universities. It suits students interested in technology management, quantitative finance and economics, in one of Europe's major financial centres.
description_cn: 苏黎世联邦理工学院管理、技术与经济系（D-MTEC）把管理与经济学教学融入全球顶尖的理工科大学，适合对科技管理、量化金融和经济学感兴趣的学生，地处欧洲重要金融中心苏黎世。

name: School of Management
description_en: UCL School of Management is one of the newest but fastest-growing business schools in the world, benefiting from UCL's top-10 global university status. Based in London's Knowledge Quarter near the British Library and the Francis Crick Institute, it is at the heart of London's innovation ecosystem. Strong links to UCL's science, engineering, and health faculties create unique interdisciplinary opportunities.
description_cn: UCL管理学院是全球最新但发展最快的商学院之一，依托UCL全球前十大学的地位。坐落于伦敦知识区，毗邻大英图书馆和弗朗西斯·克里克研究所，处于伦敦创新生态系统的核心。与UCL理工和医学院的紧密联系创造了独特的跨学科机遇。

name: NUS Business School
description_en: NUS Business School is one of Asia's leading business schools. Singapore's role as Southeast Asia's financial hub and NUS's place among the world's top universities make it a strong choice for students targeting Asian markets, and its MBA curriculum has a strong Asia focus.
description_cn: 新加坡国立大学商学院是亚洲顶尖商学院之一。新加坡作为东南亚金融中心，加上国大跻身全球顶尖大学之列，使其成为瞄准亚洲市场的学生的理想选择；MBA 课程具有鲜明的亚洲视角。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Asia's gateway MBA with exceptional China, India, and ASEAN business exposure.
programs_detail.description_cn: 亚洲门户MBA，深度融入中国、印度和东南亚商业生态。

programs_detail.name: MBA (Finance Specialisation)
programs_detail.description_en: MBA track tailored for banking, trading, and investment management careers in Asia.
programs_detail.description_cn: 专为亚洲银行、交易和投资管理职业定制的MBA专业方向。

programs_detail.name: BBA (Undergraduate)
programs_detail.description_en: Top-ranked Asian undergraduate business degree with dual-degree options across 30+ partner universities.
programs_detail.description_cn: 亚洲顶尖本科商科学位，可与30多所合作大学联合开设双学位。

programs_detail.name: MSc Finance
programs_detail.description_en: Quantitative finance master targeting Singapore and regional financial hubs.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向新加坡和地区金融中心职位的量化金融硕士。

name: HKU Business School
description_en: HKU Business School is the oldest and one of the most prestigious business schools in Hong Kong, combining British academic tradition with deep Chinese market knowledge. Hong Kong's status as Asia's premier international financial centre, combined with its unique role as the gateway between East and West, creates unparalleled learning and career opportunities.
description_cn: 香港大学经管学院是香港历史最悠久、最负盛名的商学院之一，融合英国学术传统与深厚的中国市场知识。香港作为亚洲首要国际金融中心的地位，以及其沟通东西方的独特角色，创造了无可比拟的学习和职业机遇。

name: Nanyang Business School
description_en: Nanyang Business School at NTU is known for its analytics-integrated curriculum and strong STEM foundation. NTU itself is one of the world's fastest-rising universities. The school's strong links to Singapore's deep pool of MNCs and its proximity to the ASEAN economic zone create exceptional graduate career opportunities.
description_cn: 南洋理工大学商学院以其全面整合数据分析的课程和强大的STEM基础著称。NTU本身是全球排名上升最快的大学之一。学院与新加坡众多跨国公司的紧密联系及毗邻东盟经济区的地理优势，为毕业生创造了非凡的职业机遇。

name: Guanghua School of Management
description_en: PKU Guanghua is backed by Peking University, China's foremost liberal arts and research university. Particularly strong in Finance, Economics, and Accounting research, Guanghua has close ties to China's policymaking circles and central bank. Located in the Zhongguancun tech hub of Beijing, students have direct access to China's innovation leaders.
description_cn: 北京大学光华管理学院依托中国最重要的文理研究型大学北京大学。在金融、经济学和会计研究领域尤为出色，与中国政策圈和央行联系紧密。坐落于北京中关村科技园，学生可直接接触中国创新领袖。

name: HSBC Business School
description_en: Peking University HSBC Business School (PHBS), located in Shenzhen's high-tech innovation zone, represents China's most internationally-oriented business school. With campuses in both Shenzhen and Oxford, UK, PHBS is uniquely positioned at the intersection of China's technology and finance industries, offering strong access to the Greater Bay Area ecosystem.
description_cn: 北京大学汇丰商学院（PHBS）坐落于深圳高科技创新区，是中国最具国际化导向的商学院。在深圳和英国牛津均设有校区，PHBS独特地处于中国科技和金融产业的交汇点，提供进入粤港澳大湾区生态系统的强大渠道。

name: School of Economics and Management
description_en: Tsinghua SEM is China's most prestigious business school, benefiting from 'China's MIT' reputation. Its EMBA program is the most sought-after in China, attracting the country's top business leaders. Deep connections to China's government, tech giants (Huawei, Tencent, Alibaba), and the Beijing financial community make it essential for anyone targeting China's market.
description_cn: 清华大学经管学院是中国最负盛名的商学院，依托「中国麻省理工」的声誉。其EMBA项目是中国最受追捧的高管教育项目，吸引了中国顶级商业领袖。与中国政府、科技巨头（华为、腾讯、阿里巴巴）及北京金融界的深厚联系，使其成为目标中国市场人才不可或缺的选择。

programs_detail.name: MBA (中英双语)
programs_detail.description_en: China's top MBA at Tsinghua; bilingual programme with US and European exchange partnerships.
programs_detail.description_cn: 清华大学中国顶尖MBA，双语项目，与美国和欧洲顶尖院校设有交换合作。

programs_detail.name: MBA (Global)
programs_detail.description_en: English-language MBA attracting international students and senior returning professionals.
programs_detail.description_cn: 英语授课MBA，面向国际学生和有海外经验的归国职业人士。

programs_detail.name: Master of Finance (MFin)
programs_detail.description_en: Quantitative finance master with deep links to Beijing's financial regulators and state institutions.
programs_detail.description_cn: 定量金融硕士，与北京金融监管机构和国家机构紧密联系。

programs_detail.name: EMBA
programs_detail.description_en: Executive MBA designed for senior Chinese executives, with world-class faculty.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向中国高级管理人员的EMBA，配备世界级师资阵容。

alumni_detail.name: Zhu Rongji
alumni_detail.role: Former Premier of China; founding dean of Tsinghua SEM

name: Wharton School
description_en: Founded in 1881, Wharton is the world's first collegiate business school and is especially known for finance. Its undergraduate and MBA programmes are among the most selective, and the Joseph H. Lauder Institute combines the MBA with international studies.
description_cn: 沃顿商学院创立于 1881 年，是全球第一所大学商学院，尤以金融见长。其本科与 MBA 项目都极具竞争力；约瑟夫·劳德研究院将 MBA 与国际研究相结合。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Oldest US business school MBA. Unrivalled finance, accounting, and real estate depth.
programs_detail.description_cn: 美国历史最悠久商学院的MBA项目，在金融、会计和房地产领域深度无可比拟。

programs_detail.name: BSc in Economics (Undergraduate)
programs_detail.description_en: World's most selective undergraduate business program. Produces more Wall Street analysts than any other.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全球最难录取的本科商科项目，是华尔街分析师的最大单一来源。

programs_detail.name: EMBA (Philadelphia / San Francisco / Global)
programs_detail.description_en: Executive MBA offered across three locations, including a global cohort with INSEAD.
programs_detail.description_cn: 三地高管MBA，包括与INSEAD联合开设的全球项目。

programs_detail.name: MBA / JD
programs_detail.description_en: Joint degree with Penn Law; ideal for finance law, private equity, or policy careers.
programs_detail.description_cn: 与宾大法学院联合学位，适合金融法律、私募股权或政策职业。

name: School of Management
description_en: Yale SOM distinguishes itself through a focus on business in society, public and non-profit management, and global leadership. Its integrated MBA curriculum breaks down functional silos to foster systems thinking. Students benefit from Yale's unparalleled resources across law, medicine, the arts, and public policy.
description_cn: 耶鲁管理学院以关注商业与社会、公共和非营利管理及全球领导力而独树一帜。整合式MBA课程打破功能壁垒，培养系统性思维。学生得益于耶鲁大学在法律、医学、艺术和公共政策等领域无与伦比的资源。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Integrated curriculum focusing on business and society. Exceptional for social impact careers.
programs_detail.description_cn: 以商业与社会为主线的整合式课程，在社会影响力职业发展方面尤为突出。

programs_detail.name: MBA / JD
programs_detail.description_en: Joint degree with Yale Law — the world's top-ranked law school.
programs_detail.description_cn: 与全球顶尖的耶鲁法学院联合开设的双学位项目。

programs_detail.name: MAM (Master of Advanced Management)
programs_detail.description_en: Joint program with the Yale School of Drama for arts and cultural managers.
programs_detail.description_cn: 与耶鲁戏剧学院联合开设，面向艺术和文化管理者。

programs_detail.name: MBA / MEM (Environment) joint degree
programs_detail.description_en: Joint program with Yale School of the Environment for sustainability leaders.
programs_detail.description_cn: 与耶鲁环境学院联合开设，面向可持续发展领导者。

name: CUHK Business School
description_en: CUHK Business School has the largest alumni network in Hong Kong and strong connections to mainland China's business community. It was the first school in Hong Kong to offer an MBA programme. Strong partnerships with leading mainland Chinese universities enable dual-degree and exchange opportunities not available elsewhere in Hong Kong.
description_cn: 香港中文大学商学院拥有香港最大的校友网络和与中国内地商界的紧密联系。是香港第一所开设MBA项目的商学院，与国内顶尖高校的合作伙伴关系提供了香港其他院校无法比拟的双学位和交流机会。

name: UNSW Business School / AGSM
description_en: UNSW Business School is Sydney's highest-ranked business faculty and one of Asia-Pacific's most comprehensive. Its location in Australia's largest city, home to the ASX and a thriving financial services sector, creates outstanding finance career pathways. AGSM (Australian Graduate School of Management) runs top-ranked postgraduate programmes.
description_cn: 新南威尔士大学商学院是悉尼排名最高的商学院，也是亚太地区最全面的商学院之一。坐落于澳大利亚最大城市，毗邻澳大利亚证券交易所（ASX）和蓬勃的金融服务业，提供出色的金融职业路径。澳大利亚管理研究生院（AGSM）开设顶尖研究生项目。

name: Carey Business School
description_en: Johns Hopkins Carey Business School leverages the prestige of one of the world's leading research universities. Its proximity to JHU's renowned medical and public health institutions creates unrivalled opportunities in healthcare management. The school emphasizes research-based business education with a strong focus on social impact and analytics.
description_cn: 约翰斯·霍普金斯大学凯瑞商学院依托世界顶尖研究型大学的声望。毗邻霍普金斯著名医疗和公共卫生机构，创造了无与伦比的医疗管理职业机遇。学院强调以研究为基础的商业教育，高度关注社会影响和数据分析。

name: Melbourne Business School
description_en: Melbourne Business School is Australia's most internationally recognised business school, consistently ranked in the global top 50. Melbourne is regularly voted one of the world's most liveable cities, and its diverse, cosmopolitan economy provides exceptional career opportunities across finance, healthcare, and technology. Strong links to the Asia-Pacific region are a key differentiator.
description_cn: 墨尔本商学院是澳大利亚国际知名度最高的商学院，持续跻身全球前50。墨尔本多次荣获全球最宜居城市，其多元化、国际化的经济体在金融、医疗和科技领域提供非凡的职业机遇，与亚太地区的紧密联系是其关键竞争优势。

name: Booth School of Business
description_en: The University of Chicago is associated with more Nobel laureates in economics than any other institution, and Booth's faculty have included laureates such as Eugene Fama and Richard Thaler. Research behind the efficient-market hypothesis and the Fama-French factor model was developed here, and the school's flexible curriculum attracts analytically minded students.
description_cn: 芝加哥大学是诺贝尔经济学奖得主最多的机构，布斯商学院的教授中就有法玛、塞勒等诺奖得主。有效市场假说和法玛-弗伦奇因子模型等研究诞生于此；灵活的课程设置吸引了大量擅长分析的学生。

programs_detail.name: MBA (Full-Time)
programs_detail.description_en: Highly flexible curriculum — choose any sequence of electives. Strongest finance faculty globally.
programs_detail.description_cn: 高度灵活的课程体系，任意选择选修顺序。全球最强的金融学师资阵容。

programs_detail.name: EMBA
programs_detail.description_en: Weekend Executive MBA across Chicago, London, and Hong Kong campuses.
programs_detail.description_cn: 周末高管MBA，在芝加哥、伦敦和香港三地校区开设。

programs_detail.name: Evening MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Part-time MBA for Chicago-based professionals continuing to work full-time.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向芝加哥地区在职人士的在职MBA项目。

programs_detail.name: PhD
programs_detail.description_en: Research PhD across Accounting, Economics, Econometrics & Statistics, Finance, Marketing.
programs_detail.description_cn: 覆盖会计、经济学、计量经济学与统计、金融、市场营销的研究型博士项目。

name: School of Management
description_en: Fudan School of Management benefits from Shanghai's position as China's financial capital. Strong in Marketing, Strategy, and Finance, the school has been building its international reputation rapidly through partnerships with global institutions. Shanghai's cosmopolitan environment, deep financial sector, and vibrant startup ecosystem create exceptional career prospects.
description_cn: 复旦大学管理学院得益于上海作为中国金融中心的地位，在营销、战略和金融领域实力雄厚。通过与全球机构的合作，学院正在快速提升国际声誉。上海的国际化环境、深厚的金融业和活跃的创业生态创造了非凡的职业前景。

name: The University of Sydney Business School
description_en: The University of Sydney is Australia's oldest and most prestigious university, and its Business School carries that heritage. Located on a stunning heritage campus in the heart of Sydney, students benefit from extraordinary institutional prestige and a vibrant alumni network spanning finance, law, and technology sectors across the Asia-Pacific.
description_cn: 悉尼大学是澳大利亚历史最悠久、最负盛名的大学，其商学院传承这一荣誉。坐落于悉尼市中心美丽的历史校园，学生得益于非凡的院校声望和横跨亚太地区金融、法律和科技领域的活跃校友网络。

name: Desautels Faculty of Management
description_en: McGill Desautels is one of Canada's most prestigious business schools, located in the cosmopolitan city of Montreal. Its BCom is the most selective undergraduate business program in Quebec. As part of McGill University — one of the world's top research universities — students benefit from extraordinary interdisciplinary resources.
description_cn: 麦吉尔大学德萨泰斯管理学院是加拿大最负盛名的商学院之一，坐落于国际化都市蒙特利尔。其商学学士（BCom）是魁北克竞争最激烈的本科商科项目。作为全球顶尖研究型大学麦吉尔的组成部分，学生享有非凡的跨学科资源。

name: Monash Business School
description_en: Monash Business School is one of the largest and most internationally diverse business schools in Australia. It attracts a highly multicultural student cohort reflecting Melbourne's global character. Research excellence in finance and economics, combined with a large global alumni network across Asia-Pacific, makes Monash an attractive option for international students.
description_cn: 莫纳什大学商学院是澳大利亚规模最大、国际化程度最高的商学院之一，吸引了彰显墨尔本国际化特色的高度多元文化学生群体。在金融和经济学领域的研究卓越，加上遍布亚太地区的庞大全球校友网络，使莫纳什成为国际学生的理想选择。

name: Rotman School of Management
description_en: Rotman is Canada's top-ranked business school and sits in Toronto's Bay Street financial district, Canada's equivalent of Wall Street. Roger Martin, the school's former dean, created the influential Integrative Thinking methodology. Strong in finance and consulting, Rotman graduates are highly competitive across North American markets.
description_cn: 罗特曼管理学院是加拿大排名第一的商学院，坐落于加拿大华尔街——多伦多湾街金融区。前院长罗杰·马丁创造了颇具影响力的整合性思维方法论。在金融和咨询领域实力强劲，毕业生在北美市场极具竞争力。

name: HKUST Business School
university: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
description_en: HKUST Business School is one of Asia's leading business schools. Founded in 1991, HKUST rose quickly through research strength and close ties with mainland China's technology and financial sectors.
description_cn: 香港科技大学商学院是亚洲顶尖商学院之一。港科大成立于 1991 年，凭借科研实力以及与内地科技、金融业的紧密联系迅速崛起。

name: University of Edinburgh Business School
description_en: Edinburgh Business School sits within one of the world's oldest and most respected universities, with a history dating back to 1583. Scotland's capital offers a vibrant financial services sector and an exceptionally liveable city. The school is known for its research excellence and strong ties to Scotland's growing financial and technology sectors.
description_cn: 爱丁堡大学商学院所在的爱丁堡大学历史可追溯至1583年，是全球最古老、最受尊重的大学之一。苏格兰首府爱丁堡拥有充满活力的金融服务业和极宜居的城市环境，学院以卓越的科研成果和与苏格兰金融及科技产业的紧密联系著称。

name: Antai College of Economics and Management
description_en: SJTU Antai combines the strengths of one of China's top engineering universities with comprehensive management education. AACSB-accredited, the school emphasises quantitative methods and China business strategy. Its engineering alumni network provides unique cross-disciplinary career pathways in finance, technology, and manufacturing.
description_cn: 上海交通大学安泰经济与管理学院将中国顶尖理工大学的优势与全面的管理教育相结合，获AACSB认证，强调定量方法和中国商业战略。理工科校友网络为金融、科技和制造业提供了独特的跨学科职业路径。

name: Alliance Manchester Business School
description_en: Alliance Manchester Business School is one of the UK's largest business schools. Founded in 1965 alongside London Business School as one of the UK's first two business schools, it has a long heritage in management education, and Manchester's economy offers links to manufacturing, fintech and the creative industries.
description_cn: 曼彻斯特大学联盟商学院是英国规模最大的商学院之一。它于 1965 年与伦敦商学院一起成为英国最早的两所商学院，管理教育底蕴深厚；曼彻斯特的经济为学生提供制造业、金融科技和创意产业的人脉资源。

name: Seoul National University Business School
description_en: Seoul National University Business School is Korea's most prestigious business school. Its graduates permeate Korea's leading chaebols including Samsung, Hyundai, LG, and SK, as well as government ministries. The school's global MBA program conducts its curriculum in English and attracts top international students.
description_cn: 首尔国立大学商学院是韩国最负盛名的商学院。其毕业生遍布韩国主要财阀，包括三星、现代、LG和SK，以及政府部委。学院的全球MBA项目以英语授课，吸引了顶尖国际学生。

name: Graduate School of Economics / GSFS
description_en: The University of Tokyo — Japan's most prestigious university — offers management and economics programmes that attract Japan's brightest minds. Tokyo's status as the world's 3rd-largest financial market and Japan's deep corporate sector provide extraordinary career opportunities. The school is increasingly offering English-language programmes to attract international talent.
description_cn: 东京大学是日本最负盛名的大学，提供吸引日本最优秀人才的管理和经济学项目。东京是全球第三大金融市场，日本深厚的企业资源提供了非凡的职业机遇。学院正在增加英语授课项目以吸引国际人才。

name: UQ Business School
description_en: UQ Business School is one of Australia's leading business schools, based in Brisbane. The University of Queensland draws on Queensland's resources economy and Asia-Pacific ties, and Brisbane's role as host of the 2032 Olympics is bringing new investment to the city.
description_cn: 昆士兰大学商学院是澳大利亚领先的商学院之一，位于布里斯班。学校依托昆士兰的资源型经济和亚太联系；布里斯班将举办 2032 年奥运会，正迎来新的投资。

name: School of Business
description_en: Yonsei is one of Korea's three most prestigious universities (SKY universities), and its Business School is among the country's most selective. Seoul's emergence as a global hub for finance, technology, and K-culture creates vibrant career opportunities. Strong ties to Korea's chaebols (Samsung, LG, Hyundai) provide excellent corporate connections.
description_cn: 延世大学是韩国最负盛名的三所大学（SKY）之一，其商学院是韩国竞争最激烈的商科院校之一。首尔作为金融、科技和韩流文化全球中心的崛起创造了充满活力的职业机遇。与韩国财阀（三星、LG、现代）的紧密联系提供了出色的企业资源。

name: Columbia Business School
description_en: Columbia Business School is in New York City, with direct access to Wall Street and global finance. Warren Buffett studied under Benjamin Graham here, and the school's value investing programme continues that tradition. It moved to new buildings on Columbia's Manhattanville campus in 2022.
description_cn: 哥伦比亚商学院位于纽约，可直接接触华尔街和全球金融业。巴菲特曾在此师从本杰明·格雷厄姆，学院的价值投资项目延续了这一传统；2022 年学院迁入哥大曼哈顿维尔校区的新大楼。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: NYC-based MBA with the world's strongest Wall Street recruitment pipeline.
programs_detail.description_cn: 纽约MBA项目，拥有全球最强的华尔街招聘渠道。

programs_detail.name: Executive MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Executive MBA offered with bi-weekly Friday–Saturday sessions; Paris cohort via ESCP.
programs_detail.description_cn: 每两周一次周五至周六上课的高管MBA，巴黎班与ESCP联合开设。

programs_detail.name: MS in Financial Economics
programs_detail.description_en: Quantitative master's bridging economics theory and financial market practice.
programs_detail.description_cn: 连接经济学理论与金融市场实践的定量金融经济学硕士。

programs_detail.name: MS in Marketing Science
programs_detail.description_en: Analytical marketing master leveraging CBS's strength in data-driven strategy.
programs_detail.description_cn: 依托CBS数据驱动战略优势的分析型市场营销硕士。

name: Kellogg School of Management
description_en: Kellogg is long known for marketing and for its collaborative, team-oriented culture, and it sends a large share of its MBAs into consulting. Its MMM programme, run with Northwestern's McCormick School of Engineering, combines an MBA with design and innovation training.
description_cn: 凯洛格商学院长期以市场营销见长，以协作、团队导向的文化闻名，MBA 毕业生进入咨询行业的比例很高。与西北大学麦考密克工程学院合办的 MMM 项目把 MBA 与设计、创新训练结合在一起。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: #1 global MBA for Marketing and Consulting. Highly team-oriented culture.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全球营销与咨询方向排名第一的MBA，以高度团队协作的文化著称。

programs_detail.name: MMM (MBA + MEM)
programs_detail.description_en: Joint MBA + Master of Engineering Management with Northwestern's McCormick School.
programs_detail.description_cn: 与西北大学麦考密克工程学院联合开设的MBA+工程管理硕士双学位。

programs_detail.name: EMBA (Evanston / Miami / Global)
programs_detail.description_en: Highly ranked executive MBA with campuses across North America and a global offering.
programs_detail.description_cn: 在北美多地及全球开设的高排名高管MBA项目。

name: Sauder School of Business
description_en: UBC Sauder sits on the Pacific coast of Canada, just a 2-hour flight from major Asian financial centres. This geographic advantage, combined with Vancouver's vibrant tech and resources sectors, creates unique Asia-Pacific business opportunities. The Centre for Urban Economics and Real Estate is among the best globally.
description_cn: UBC商学院位于加拿大太平洋海岸，距亚洲主要金融中心仅两小时航程。这一地理优势，结合温哥华蓬勃发展的科技和资源产业，创造了独特的亚太商业机遇。其城市经济和房地产研究中心跻身全球最佳之列。

name: School of Management
description_en: Zhejiang University School of Management is strategically located in Hangzhou, China's digital economy capital, home to Alibaba, NetEase, and Hikvision. The school's emphasis on entrepreneurship and digital innovation reflects its environment. Its proximity to China's e-commerce epicenter creates exceptional opportunities in tech entrepreneurship.
description_cn: 浙江大学管理学院战略性地坐落于杭州——中国数字经济之都，阿里巴巴、网易和海康威视的所在地。学院对创业和数字创新的强调反映了其所处环境。毗邻中国电子商务中心，为科技创业提供了卓越机遇。

name: Anderson School of Management
description_en: UCLA Anderson is uniquely positioned at the intersection of technology, entertainment, and finance in Los Angeles. Its strong ties to Hollywood, Silicon Beach, and the broader LA tech ecosystem create extraordinary opportunities. The school is known for its collaborative culture and the Applied Management Research (AMR) program.
description_cn: 加州大学洛杉矶分校安德森管理学院独特地处于洛杉矶的科技、娱乐和金融交汇处，与好莱坞、硅滩及更广泛的洛杉矶科技生态系统的紧密联系创造了非凡机遇。学院以协作文化和应用管理研究（AMR）项目闻名。

name: Ross School of Business
description_en: Michigan Ross is one of the leading public business schools in the United States. Its signature MAP (Multidisciplinary Action Projects) course gives MBA students a seven-week real-world consulting project, and it also runs a large, highly regarded BBA programme.
description_cn: 密歇根大学罗斯商学院是美国顶尖的公立商学院之一。其标志性的 MAP（多学科行动项目）让 MBA 学生完成为期七周的真实咨询项目，本科 BBA 项目同样规模大、口碑好。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Strong public school MBA with MAP consulting project and Ford Motor Co. ties.
programs_detail.description_cn: 出色的公立商学院MBA，以MAP咨询项目和与福特汽车的紧密关系著称。

programs_detail.name: BBA (Undergraduate)
programs_detail.description_en: Top-ranked undergraduate business program with deep career networks in auto, finance, and consulting.
programs_detail.description_cn: 顶尖本科商科项目，在汽车、金融和咨询行业拥有深厚的职业网络。

programs_detail.name: MAcc
programs_detail.description_en: Master of Accounting with exceptional Big 4 placement rates.
programs_detail.description_cn: 会计硕士，四大会计师事务所录取率极为出色。

programs_detail.name: Global MBA
programs_detail.description_en: MBA with mandatory international business module and global cohort focus.
programs_detail.description_cn: 包含必修国际商务模块的全球化MBA项目。

name: College of Business
description_en: CityU College of Business is known for its strong industry connections and practical, career-focused programmes. Its accounting and finance programmes are particularly strong, and the school enjoys excellent links to Hong Kong's business community. An accessible entry point to Hong Kong's competitive financial and professional services sectors.
description_cn: 香港城市大学商学院以其强大的行业联系和注重实践的职业导向项目著称。会计和金融项目尤为突出，与香港商界拥有出色的联系，是进入香港竞争激烈的金融和专业服务业的理想起点。

name: Tepper School of Business
description_en: Carnegie Mellon Tepper pioneered quantitative management education and was the first school to use operations research methods in business. Its MS in Computational Finance (MSCF) is consistently ranked #1 globally. Located in Pittsburgh's thriving tech hub, Tepper graduates are highly sought by finance and technology firms.
description_cn: 卡内基梅隆大学泰珀商学院开创了定量管理教育，是第一所将运筹学方法应用于商业的学校。其计算金融硕士（MSCF）项目持续荣登全球第一。坐落于匹兹堡蓬勃发展的科技中心，泰珀毕业生深受金融和科技公司追捧。

name: Faculty of Business and Economics
description_en: University of Malaya's Faculty of Business and Economics is Malaysia's most prestigious business school. The school is particularly recognized for its Islamic finance programs, reflecting Malaysia's position as the global leader in Islamic finance and sukuk markets. UM's diverse student body and ASEAN connections create excellent regional opportunities.
description_cn: 马来亚大学商业与经济学院是马来西亚最负盛名的商学院。学院因其伊斯兰金融项目而特别受到认可，这反映了马来西亚在全球伊斯兰金融和伊斯兰债券市场的领先地位。马大多元化的学生群体和东盟联系为整个地区创造了卓越机遇。

name: Graduate School of Management
description_en: Kyoto University's Graduate School of Management is one of Japan's most respected business programmes. Japan's ancient capital provides a unique cultural backdrop for studying business, innovation, and sustainability. The school has a particular strength in connecting business education with Kyoto's world-class technology and pharmaceutical industries.
description_cn: 京都大学管理学院是日本最受尊敬的商科项目之一。日本古都为研究商业、创新和可持续发展提供了独特的文化背景，学院在将商业教育与京都世界级科技和制药产业相结合方面具有独特优势。

name: Stern School of Business
description_en: NYU Stern sits in Greenwich Village, a short trip from Wall Street, and is one of the most finance-focused business schools. Its undergraduate business programme and MS in Quantitative Finance are well known, and New York gives students wide access to finance, media and technology internships.
description_cn: 纽约大学斯特恩商学院位于格林威治村，距华尔街不远，是最偏重金融的商学院之一。本科商科和量化金融硕士知名度高，纽约为学生提供了丰富的金融、传媒和科技实习机会。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: NYC finance-focused MBA with unparalleled Wall Street and media industry access.
programs_detail.description_cn: 以金融为核心的纽约MBA，华尔街和媒体行业资源无与伦比。

programs_detail.name: BS in Business (Undergraduate)
programs_detail.description_en: Top-ranked undergraduate business program with specializations in finance, accounting, and fintech.
programs_detail.description_cn: 顶尖本科商科项目，提供金融、会计和金融科技专业方向。

programs_detail.name: MS in Quantitative Finance
programs_detail.description_en: Quant finance master for derivatives, risk, and algorithmic trading roles.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向衍生品、风险管理和量化交易职位的量化金融硕士。

name: Amsterdam Business School
description_en: Amsterdam Business School sits within one of Europe's most beautiful and liveable cities and one of its oldest universities. Amsterdam serves as the European hub for hundreds of multinationals, including ASML, ING, Heineken, and Booking.com, giving students extraordinary internship and career access. Strong research tradition in finance, marketing, and economics.
description_cn: 阿姆斯特丹商学院所在的阿姆斯特丹大学是欧洲最古老的大学之一，城市美丽宜居。阿姆斯特丹是数百家跨国公司的欧洲总部所在地，包括ASML、ING、喜力和Booking.com，为学生提供非凡的实习和职业机会。在金融、营销和经济学领域拥有深厚的研究传统。

name: Department of Management / LSE
university: London School of Economics and Political Science
description_en: LSE is globally recognised as the leading social science university, producing numerous Nobel Prize winners in Economics. Its finance and economics programmes are world-renowned, and its alumni hold leadership positions in central banks, governments, and top financial institutions worldwide. The school's central London location is unbeatable for networking.
description_cn: 伦敦政治经济学院是全球公认的顶尖社会科学大学，培养了众多诺贝尔经济学奖得主。其金融和经济学项目享誉全球，校友在全球各地央行、政府机构和顶尖金融机构担任领导职位。学院位于伦敦市中心，人脉资源无可比拟。

programs_detail.name: MSc Management
programs_detail.description_en: Rigorous management master drawing on LSE's world-leading social science research.
programs_detail.description_cn: 严格的管理硕士，依托LSE世界顶尖的社会科学研究积淀。

programs_detail.name: MSc Finance
programs_detail.description_en: Finance master grounded in economic theory, targeting banking, asset management, and research.
programs_detail.description_cn: 以经济理论为基础的金融硕士，面向银行、资产管理和研究职位。

programs_detail.name: BSc Management
programs_detail.description_en: Highly selective undergraduate programme combining management, economics, and social science.
programs_detail.description_cn: 竞争激烈的本科项目，融合管理学、经济学和社会科学。

programs_detail.name: MPA (Master of Public Administration)
programs_detail.description_en: Leading public policy master attracting future government and international organisation leaders.
programs_detail.description_cn: 顶尖公共政策硕士，吸引未来政府和国际组织领导者。

alumni_detail.name: George Soros
alumni_detail.role: Founder, Soros Fund Management (LSE BSc, MSc)

alumni_detail.name: Jomo Kenyatta
alumni_detail.role: First President of Kenya (studied at LSE)

name: College of Business
university: KAIST – Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology
description_en: KAIST College of Business combines Korea's premier science and technology university with business education. Its MBA program is unique for its deep integration with engineering and science departments, making it ideal for technology commercialization and managing innovation. Its graduates are highly sought after in Korea's tech industry and global R&D organizations.
description_cn: 韩国科学技术院商学院将韩国顶尖理工科大学与商业教育相结合。其MBA项目因与工程和科学院系的深度融合而独具特色，非常适合技术商业化和创新管理。其毕业生在韩国科技行业和全球研发机构中备受青睐。

name: University of Auckland Business School
description_en: University of Auckland Business School is New Zealand's largest and most internationally recognized business school, triple-accredited (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA). Auckland is New Zealand's commercial capital with strong ties to Australia and Pacific Rim economies. The school's research strength in finance and information systems, combined with New Zealand's quality of life, makes it compelling for international students.
description_cn: 奥克兰大学商学院是新西兰最大、国际认可度最高的商学院，拥有三重认证（AACSB、EQUIS、AMBA）。奥克兰是新西兰的商业之都，与澳大利亚和太平洋沿岸经济体联系紧密。学院在金融和信息系统方面的研究实力，加上新西兰的生活品质，使其成为国际学生的优选目的地。

name: Warwick Business School
description_en: Warwick Business School is triple-accredited (AACSB, EQUIS, AMBA) and known for finance and accounting research. It runs a well-regarded distance-learning MBA, and its London base at The Shard complements the main campus near Coventry.
description_cn: 华威商学院拥有 AACSB、EQUIS、AMBA 三重认证，金融与会计研究实力强；远程 MBA 项目口碑良好，位于伦敦碎片大厦的校区与考文垂附近的主校区互为补充。

name: Fuqua School of Business
description_en: Duke Fuqua is known for its collaborative 'Team Fuqua' culture and for strengths in healthcare and energy alongside finance and strategy. Besides the Daytime MBA it offers executive formats such as the Weekend Executive MBA and Global Executive MBA.
description_cn: 杜克大学福库商学院以协作的「Team Fuqua」文化著称，除金融和战略外，在医疗健康和能源方向也很有特色；除全日制 MBA 外，还开设周末高管 MBA、全球高管 MBA 等项目。

name: Trinity Business School
description_en: Trinity Business School at Trinity College Dublin benefits from Ireland's position as the European hub for technology giants including Google, Apple, Facebook, and LinkedIn. Dublin's vibrant tech ecosystem and Trinity's 400-year academic heritage create a unique environment for business education.
description_cn: 都柏林圣三一学院商学院受益于爱尔兰作为谷歌、苹果、脸书和领英等科技巨头欧洲总部的地位。都柏林充满活力的科技生态系统和圣三一学院400年的学术遗产，为商业教育创造了独特环境。

name: Marshall School of Business
description_en: USC Marshall School of Business in Los Angeles is uniquely positioned at the intersection of finance, technology, and entertainment. Its strong alumni network in Hollywood and Silicon Beach, combined with access to LA's global business community, makes it a top choice for those seeking careers in media, tech, and international business.
description_cn: 南加大马歇尔商学院地处洛杉矶，独特地处于金融、科技与娱乐行业的交汇点。强大的好莱坞和硅滩校友网络，加上进入洛杉矶全球商业社区的渠道，使其成为媒体、科技和国际商业领域求职者的首选。

name: Jones Graduate School of Business
description_en: Rice Jones Graduate School of Business sits at the heart of Houston, the global capital of the energy industry. Its MBA program is uniquely positioned for careers in energy, health sciences, and finance, while maintaining the intimacy and collaborative culture of Rice University.
description_cn: 莱斯大学琼斯商学院位于全球能源工业之都休斯顿的核心地带。其MBA项目在能源、健康科学和金融领域的职业发展上独树一帜，同时保持着莱斯大学亲密协作的文化。

name: Graduate School of Management
description_en: UC Davis Graduate School of Management leverages California's land-grant research university strengths and its proximity to Sacramento and the San Francisco Bay Area. The school is renowned for its wine business program, agribusiness management, and data analytics focus.
description_cn: 加州大学戴维斯分校管理研究生院依托加州土地授予研究型大学的优势及毗邻萨克拉门托和旧金山湾区的地理优势。学院以葡萄酒商业项目、农业综合经营管理和数据分析方向著称。

name: Rotterdam School of Management
description_en: Rotterdam School of Management at Erasmus University is Europe's gateway to global business, located in Rotterdam—Europe's largest port city. RSM is triple-accredited and consistently ranked among Europe's best. Its highly international community and strong links to multinational corporations create extraordinary career opportunities.
description_cn: 鹿特丹伊拉斯谟大学管理学院是欧洲进入全球商业的门户，坐落于欧洲最大港口城市鹿特丹。RSM三重认证，长期跻身欧洲最佳之列。高度国际化的社区及与跨国公司的紧密联系，创造了非凡的职业机遇。

name: Ivey Business School
description_en: Ivey is Canada's best-known case-method business school. Its HBA (Honors Business Administration) undergraduate degree, taken in the final two years of study, is one of the most respected business degrees in Canada.
description_cn: 毅伟商学院是加拿大最知名的案例教学商学院。其本科后两年的 HBA（荣誉工商管理）学位是加拿大最受认可的商科学位之一。

name: Olin Business School
description_en: Washington University's Olin Business School benefits from WashU's exceptional research standing and St. Louis's growing innovation ecosystem. The school is known for its collaborative culture and access to the university's excellence in medicine, law, and engineering, enabling truly cross-disciplinary education.
description_cn: 华盛顿大学奥林商学院受益于WashU卓越的研究地位和圣路易斯蓬勃发展的创新生态系统。学院以其协作文化以及进入医学、法学和工程学卓越领域的渠道而著称，实现真正跨学科教育。

name: W. P. Carey School of Business
description_en: Arizona State W.P. Carey School of Business is one of the nation's largest business schools and a pioneer in online MBA education. Known for its strength in supply chain management, real estate, and information management, the school serves a large and diverse student body across multiple campuses and online platforms.
description_cn: 亚利桑那州立大学W.P.凯瑞商学院是美国最大的商学院之一，是在线MBA教育的先驱。以供应链管理、房地产和信息管理方面的优势著称，学院在多个校区和在线平台服务于庞大多元的学生群体。

name: Indian Institute of Management Ahmedabad
description_en: IIM Ahmedabad is India's best-known management institute. It was founded in 1961 with support from the Ford Foundation and Harvard Business School, uses the case method, and admits students to its flagship PGP through the highly competitive CAT exam.
description_cn: 印度管理学院艾哈迈达巴德分校是印度最知名的管理学院，1961 年在福特基金会和哈佛商学院支持下创立，采用案例教学，旗舰 PGP 项目通过竞争极其激烈的 CAT 考试录取。

alumni_detail.name: Raghuram Rajan
alumni_detail.role: Former Governor, Reserve Bank of India (PGP)

name: Goizueta Business School
description_en: Emory Goizueta Business School is situated in Atlanta, home to Coca-Cola, Delta Air Lines, and CNN. Named for the late Roberto Goizueta, former CEO of Coca-Cola, the school emphasizes principled leadership and maintains a tight-knit community that fosters exceptional alumni loyalty.
description_cn: 埃默里大学戈伊苏埃塔商学院位于亚特兰大，可口可乐、达美航空和CNN的所在地。学院以可口可乐前CEO Roberto Goizueta命名，强调有原则的领导力，并维系着一个紧密的社区，培育卓越的校友忠诚度。

name: UCT Graduate School of Business
description_en: UCT Graduate School of Business is Africa's top-ranked business school, consistently recognized by the FT as the continent's leading MBA program. The school's emphasis on African-context business education, sustainable development, and inclusive growth sets it apart globally. Its alumni network spans African governments, development banks, and corporations from Cape Town to Cairo.
description_cn: 开普敦大学商业研究生院是非洲排名最高的商学院，长期被FT认定为非洲大陆领先的MBA项目。学院对非洲背景商业教育、可持续发展和包容性增长的重视使其在全球独树一帜。其校友网络遍及从开普敦到开罗的非洲各国政府、开发银行和企业。

name: Fisher College of Business
description_en: Ohio State Fisher College of Business is a flagship business school of one of America's largest research universities. Located in Columbus—home to major corporations including Nationwide, Cardinal Health, and JPMorgan Chase—Fisher benefits from direct industry access and a massive alumni network of over 500,000 worldwide.
description_cn: 俄亥俄州立大学费舍尔商学院是美国最大研究型大学之一的旗舰商学院。位于哥伦布市，受益于直接的行业渠道和超过50万人的庞大全球校友网络。

name: Waseda Business School
description_en: Waseda Business School is one of Japan's most prestigious MBA programs, offered by Japan's leading private research university. The school's strong international focus, extensive global partnerships, and central Tokyo location make it a top destination for professionals seeking to advance careers in Japan and across Asia.
description_cn: 早稻田大学商学院是日本最负盛名的MBA项目之一，由日本领先的私立研究型大学早稻田大学提供。学院强烈的国际化导向、广泛的全球合作伙伴关系以及位于东京中心，使其成为寻求在日本和整个亚洲推进职业发展的专业人士的首选目的地。

name: Macquarie Business School
description_en: Macquarie Business School in Sydney is renowned for producing finance professionals who excel in Sydney's financial services sector. The school's actuarial studies and applied finance programs are among the most respected in Australia. Its location in Sydney's innovation district and strong industry partnerships with financial services firms make it a powerhouse for finance career development.
description_cn: 悉尼麦考瑞大学商学院以培养能在该市繁荣金融服务业中脱颖而出的金融专才而闻名。学院的精算研究和应用金融项目是澳大利亚最受尊重的之一。位于悉尼创新区的地理优势，加上与金融服务公司的强大行业合作伙伴关系，使其成为金融职业发展的重要机构。

name: Sasin School of Management
description_en: Chulalongkorn's Sasin School of Management is Thailand's most prestigious business school and the only school in Thailand with partnerships with both Kellogg (Northwestern) and Wharton (Penn). Located in Bangkok, ASEAN's largest city, Sasin offers exceptional access to Thailand's corporate landscape and ASEAN business opportunities.
description_cn: 朱拉隆功大学Sasin管理学院是泰国最负盛名的商学院，也是泰国唯一同时与凯洛格（西北大学）和沃顿（宾夕法尼亚大学）合作的学院。位于曼谷——东盟最大的城市和商业中心，Sasin提供了进入泰国企业界和东盟商业机遇的卓越渠道。

name: Suliman S. Olayan School of Business
description_en: The American University of Beirut Olayan School of Business is the Middle East's most historically prestigious business school, combining American liberal arts education with deep regional expertise. AUB consistently attracts top talent from across the Arab world. Its graduates lead major financial institutions, government bodies, and corporations throughout the MENA region.
description_cn: 贝鲁特美国大学欧拉雅商学院是中东历史最悠久、最负盛名的商学院，将美式博雅教育与深厚的地区专业知识相结合。AUB持续吸引来自阿拉伯世界各地的顶尖人才。其毕业生在整个中东和北非地区的主要金融机构、政府机构和企业中担任领导职位。

name: Wellington School of Business and Government
description_en: Victoria University of Wellington's business school is New Zealand's capital city business school, home to the national government and major public sector institutions. This location creates unrivalled opportunities in public sector management and the intersection of business and government. It is New Zealand's leading school for public management.
description_cn: 惠灵顿维多利亚大学商学院是新西兰首都的商学院，这里是国家政府和主要公共机构所在地。这一位置在公共部门管理以及商业与政府交汇处创造了无与伦比的机遇。是新西兰领先的公共管理学院。

name: Indian Institute of Management Bangalore
description_en: IIM Bangalore is India's premier management institute for technology and entrepreneurship, located at the heart of India's Silicon Valley. Its proximity to Bangalore's booming IT ecosystem, including Infosys and Wipro, gives graduates exceptional access to technology management roles. IIMB is also recognized for its public policy and social sector impact programs.
description_cn: 印度管理学院班加罗尔分院是印度科技和创业领域首屈一指的管理学院，位于印度硅谷的核心地带。毗邻班加罗尔蓬勃发展的IT生态系统，包括印孚瑟斯和威普罗，为毕业生提供了卓越的科技管理职位渠道。IIMB还以其公共政策和社会部门影响力项目而著称。

name: Carlson School of Management
description_en: Carlson School of Management at the University of Minnesota is the business hub of the Twin Cities, home to more Fortune 500 companies per capita than any other metro area. Its strong ties to 3M, Target, and UnitedHealth Group create exceptional internship and employment opportunities.
description_cn: 明尼苏达大学卡尔森管理学院是双城地区的商业中心，这里人均财富500强企业数量位居全美都会区首位。与3M、塔吉特和联合健康集团等行业巨头的紧密联系，为学生创造了卓越的实习和就业机会。

name: Owen Graduate School of Management
description_en: Vanderbilt Owen Graduate School of Management is part of a world-class research university in Nashville. The school's small program size creates an unusually close-knit community. Its healthcare management track benefits from Vanderbilt's world-renowned medical center.
description_cn: 范德堡大学欧文管理研究生院隶属纳什维尔一所世界级研究型大学。学院小规模的项目形成了异常紧密的社区。医疗管理方向受益于范德堡大学世界知名的医疗中心。

name: School of Business
description_en: Sun Yat-sen University School of Business is one of South China's most prestigious business schools, located in Guangzhou at the heart of the Pearl River Delta and Greater Bay Area. Its proximity to Hong Kong and Shenzhen's financial centers makes it a key institution for finance and international business careers in South China.
description_cn: 中山大学管理学院是华南地区最负盛名的商学院之一，坐落于广州珠三角和粤港澳大湾区的核心地带。毗邻香港和深圳金融中心，使其成为华南金融和国际商业职业发展的重要机构。

name: Copenhagen Business School
description_en: Copenhagen Business School is one of the largest business schools in Europe and the flagship of Scandinavian management education. Denmark's commitment to sustainability, work-life balance, and progressive governance makes CBS an ideal setting for studying responsible business. Strong in finance, economics, and sustainability management.
description_cn: 哥本哈根商学院是欧洲规模最大的商学院之一，也是斯堪的纳维亚管理教育的旗帜。丹麦对可持续发展、工作与生活平衡及进步治理的承诺，使CBS成为研究负责任商业的理想场所，在金融、经济学和可持续管理领域实力强劲。

name: Indian Institute of Management Calcutta
description_en: IIM Calcutta, founded in 1961, is India's oldest IIM and has pioneered management education in the country. Co-founded with assistance from MIT Sloan and the Ford Foundation, IIM-C is particularly recognized for its strength in finance, operations, and strategy. Its graduates are among the most sought-after by top global consulting and investment banking firms recruiting in India.
description_cn: 印度管理学院加尔各答分院创建于1961年，是印度历史最悠久的IIM，开创了该国管理教育的先河。在麻省理工斯隆和福特基金会协助下创立，IIM-C在金融、运营和战略方面的优势尤为突出。其毕业生是在印度招聘的顶级全球咨询和投资银行公司最青睐的对象之一。

name: McDonough School of Business
description_en: Georgetown McDonough benefits from its unique Washington D.C. location at the nexus of global politics, policy, and finance. Its Jesuit tradition emphasizes ethics and service alongside business excellence. Exceptional consulting, finance, and international business placements leverage DC's proximity to government agencies, think tanks, and international organizations.
description_cn: 乔治城大学麦克多诺商学院依托华盛顿特区这一全球政治、政策和金融交汇点的独特地理优势，耶稣会传统强调商业卓越与伦理服务并重。出色的咨询、金融和国际商务就业成绩得益于邻近政府机构、智库和国际组织。

name: Mendoza College of Business
description_en: Notre Dame Mendoza College of Business is consistently ranked among the nation's top MBA programs and is particularly celebrated for its emphasis on ethical leadership and integrity. Notre Dame's strong identity fosters a values-driven culture, and its tight-knit alumni community provides exceptional networking.
description_cn: 圣母大学门多萨商学院长期跻身全美顶级MBA项目之列，以强调道德领导力和诚信而著称。圣母大学鲜明的身份培育了价值观导向的文化，其紧密的校友社区提供了卓越的社交网络。

name: Kelley School of Business
description_en: Indiana University's Kelley School of Business is especially known for its highly ranked accounting programme and its large undergraduate business programme, including a direct-admit pathway for first-year students. Its online MBA is also well regarded.
description_cn: 印第安纳大学凯利商学院以排名靠前的会计专业和庞大的本科商科项目著称，并为新生提供直录通道；其在线 MBA 同样口碑良好。

name: Lee Kong Chian School of Business
description_en: SMU Lee Kong Chian School of Business is located in the heart of Singapore's civic and cultural district, steps from the financial CBD. Unlike NUS and NTU, SMU uses a seminar-style interactive pedagogy. Its city campus model and strong industry integration make it particularly effective for developing real-world business skills.
description_cn: 新加坡管理大学李光前商学院坐落于新加坡市政文化区核心，距金融中央商务区咫尺之遥。与NUS和NTU不同，SMU采用研讨会式互动教学法。城市校区模式和强大的行业整合使其在培养现实商业技能方面尤为有效。

name: Hitotsubashi ICS
description_en: Hitotsubashi ICS (International Corporate Strategy) is Japan's most internationally recognized business school, offering a fully English-language MBA program designed for global business leaders. Located in central Tokyo, the school bridges Japan's corporate world and global business. Its alumni network spans major Japanese corporations, financial institutions, and global consulting firms.
description_cn: 一桥大学ICS（国际企业战略）是日本最具国际认可度的商学院，提供专为全球商业领袖设计的全英文MBA项目。位于东京中心，学院是日本企业界和全球商业之间的桥梁。其校友网络遍及日本主要企业集团、金融机构和全球咨询公司。

name: School of Business
description_en: The American University in Cairo School of Business is Egypt's most prestigious business school. Located in New Cairo, AUC brings American-style education to one of the world's largest markets. Egypt's strategic position between Africa, the Middle East, and Europe, combined with its massive young population, offers graduates unique exposure to emerging market dynamics.
description_cn: 开罗美国大学商学院是埃及最负盛名的商学院之一。位于新开罗的现代化校园，AUC商学院将美式教育引入世界最大市场之一。埃及介于非洲、中东和欧洲之间的战略位置，加上其庞大的年轻人口，为毕业生提供了接触新兴市场动态的独特机遇。

name: SDA Bocconi School of Management
description_en: Bocconi University and its SDA Bocconi School of Management are Europe's premier economics and business institution in Italy, placed in Milan—Europe's fashion and design capital and a major financial center. Bocconi is uniquely positioned for careers in luxury goods, fashion, media, and European finance.
description_cn: 博科尼大学及其SDA博科尼管理学院是意大利乃至欧洲顶尖的经济与商业机构，坐落于米兰——欧洲时尚设计之都和主要金融中心之一。博科尼在奢侈品、时尚、媒体和欧洲金融领域的职业发展上独具优势。

alumni_detail.name: Mario Monti
alumni_detail.role: Former Prime Minister of Italy (Bocconi graduate, later its president)

name: China Europe International Business School
description_en: CEIBS was founded in 1994 as a joint venture between the Shanghai municipal government and the European Union. It combines China market expertise with global management teaching and is widely regarded as one of Asia's leading MBA and EMBA providers.
description_cn: 中欧国际工商学院于 1994 年由上海市政府与欧盟合作创办，将中国市场洞察与全球管理教学相结合，被普遍视为亚洲领先的 MBA 和 EMBA 院校之一。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Asia's highest-ranked MBA in FT rankings, combining Chinese market expertise with global perspective.
programs_detail.description_cn: 亚洲《金融时报》排名最高的MBA，融合中国市场专业知识与全球视野。

programs_detail.name: Global EMBA (GEMBA)
programs_detail.description_en: Executive MBA entirely in English for senior professionals with significant international exposure.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向具有丰富国际经验的高级专业人士的全英语高管MBA。

programs_detail.name: EMBA (中英双语)
programs_detail.description_en: Bilingual EMBA covering China business strategy for senior executives.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向高级管理人员的双语EMBA，深度涵盖中国商业战略。

programs_detail.name: Finance MBA (FiMBA)
programs_detail.description_en: Specialised MBA for finance professionals targeting China's capital markets and banking sector.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向金融专业人士的专项MBA，聚焦中国资本市场和银行业。

name: ESADE Business School
description_en: ESADE Business School in Barcelona is consistently ranked among Europe's top business schools, distinguished by its Jesuit humanistic values and strong emphasis on leadership development and social responsibility. Its triple-accredited programs and diverse international student body make it a premier destination for global business education.
description_cn: 巴塞罗那ESADE商学院长期跻身欧洲顶级商学院之列，以耶稣会人文主义价值观和对领导力发展与社会责任的高度重视而独树一帜。三重认证项目和多元化的国际学生群体使其成为全球商业教育的顶级目的地。

name: HEC Paris
description_en: HEC Paris is one of Europe's leading business schools and the top French grande école de commerce. Its Grande École (Master in Management) programme is highly selective, its MBA lasts about 16 months, and its graduates are prominent in French business leadership, consulting and finance.
description_cn: 巴黎高等商学院是欧洲顶尖商学院、法国排名第一的高等商学院。其 Grande École（管理学硕士）项目竞争激烈，MBA 学制约 16 个月，校友在法国企业高层、咨询和金融领域影响力很大。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Europe's top MBA; strong consulting and luxury goods placement in Paris ecosystem.
programs_detail.description_cn: 欧洲顶尖MBA，在巴黎生态圈的咨询和奢侈品行业就业表现突出。

programs_detail.name: Masters in Management (MiM)
programs_detail.description_en: Grande École MiM, consistently ranked #1 globally by FT. For pre-experience graduates.
programs_detail.description_cn: 《金融时报》持续全球排名第一的大学校管理硕士，面向应届毕业生。

programs_detail.name: MSc Finance
programs_detail.description_en: Specialized finance master targeting investment banking, M&A, and asset management.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向投资银行、并购和资产管理的专项金融硕士。

programs_detail.name: MSc Sustainability & Social Innovation
programs_detail.description_en: Unique program at the frontier of impact investing and ESG strategy.
programs_detail.description_cn: 影响力投资和ESG战略前沿的独特项目。

name: IE Business School
description_en: IE Business School in Madrid is one of Europe's most entrepreneurial business schools, known for innovation in pedagogy and a strong startup culture. It attracts a highly international student body from 130+ countries and places graduates across top firms globally. Madrid's growing tech and startup scene provides an exciting backdrop.
description_cn: 马德里IE商学院是欧洲最具创业精神的商学院之一，以教学法创新和浓厚的创业文化著称。吸引来自130多个国家的高度国际化学生，毕业生遍布全球顶尖企业。马德里日益蓬勃的科技和创业生态提供了充满活力的学习环境。

name: INSEAD
description_en: INSEAD calls itself 'The Business School for the World'. Its 10-month MBA runs across campuses in Fontainebleau (France) and Singapore, with a further campus in Abu Dhabi, and its classes are among the most international of any MBA. It regularly ranks among the Financial Times' top MBA programmes.
description_cn: 欧洲工商管理学院自称「世界的商学院」，10 个月的 MBA 在法国枫丹白露和新加坡校区同步进行，另有阿布扎比校区，学生国际化程度在所有 MBA 中名列前茅，经常位列《金融时报》全球 MBA 排名前列。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: The world's most international MBA. Campuses in Fontainebleau, Singapore, and Abu Dhabi.
programs_detail.description_cn: 全球国际化程度最高的MBA，在枫丹白露、新加坡和阿布扎比均设有校区。

programs_detail.name: EMBA (Europe / Asia)
programs_detail.description_en: Executive MBA with European and Asian tracks; modular format for senior leaders.
programs_detail.description_cn: 设有欧洲和亚洲分轨的高管MBA，模块化设计适合高级管理者。

programs_detail.name: Global EMBA (with Wharton)
programs_detail.description_en: Joint Executive MBA with Wharton — an unparalleled dual-credential for global executives.
programs_detail.description_cn: 与沃顿联合高管MBA，为全球高管提供无与伦比的双证书。

programs_detail.name: Master in Finance (MiF)
programs_detail.description_en: Pre- and post-experience finance master offered across INSEAD campuses.
programs_detail.description_cn: 在INSEAD各校区开设的适合应届和在职人士的金融硕士。

name: NHH Norwegian School of Economics
description_en: NHH Norwegian School of Economics is the leading business school in Norway and among the most respected in the Nordic region. Bergen is the historic capital of the Norwegian maritime and energy industries. NHH's strong economics tradition, combined with Norway's enormous sovereign wealth fund ecosystem, makes it exceptional for finance, energy, and shipping careers.
description_cn: 挪威经济学院（NHH）是挪威首屈一指的商学院，也是北欧地区最受推崇的商学院之一。卑尔根是挪威海事和能源产业的历史之都。NHH强大的经济学传统，结合挪威庞大的主权财富基金生态系统，使其在金融、能源和航运职业方面表现卓越。

name: Stockholm School of Economics
description_en: Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) is the preeminent business school in the Nordic region, known for its high academic standards and influential alumni network. As a standalone business school with a strong research tradition, SSE combines rigorous economics with practical business education in one of Europe's most innovative cities.
description_cn: 斯德哥尔摩经济学院（SSE）是北欧地区卓越的商学院，以高学术标准和影响力深远的校友网络著称。作为拥有强大研究传统的独立商学院，SSE在欧洲最具创新活力的城市之一，将严格的经济学与实践商业教育相结合。

name: University of St. Gallen (HSG)
description_en: The University of St. Gallen (HSG) is Switzerland's premier business school, consistently ranked among Europe's best. Close to Lake Constance and an hour from Zurich, HSG combines strong academic research with practical business education. Its emphasis on law and economics integration sets it apart, with exceptional access to German, Swiss, and Austrian business.
description_cn: 圣加仑大学（HSG）是瑞士顶尖商学院，长期跻身欧洲最佳之列。毗邻博登湖，距苏黎世仅一小时，HSG将强大的学术研究与实践商业教育相结合。其对法学与经济学融合的强调使其与众不同，为进入德国、瑞士和奥地利商业提供了卓越渠道。

name: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
university: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management
description_en: WHU – Otto Beisheim School of Management is Germany's top private business school and consistently ranked among Europe's elite. Known for its entrepreneurial spirit, international orientation, and strong alumni network, WHU produces highly sought-after graduates for top consulting firms, investment banks, and tech companies across Europe.
description_cn: WHU奥托拜斯海姆管理学院是德国顶尖私立商学院，长期跻身欧洲精英之列。以创业精神、国际化导向和强大的校友网络著称，WHU培养了备受欧洲顶级咨询公司、投资银行和科技公司青睐的优秀毕业生。

name: London Business School
description_en: London Business School is a stand-alone graduate business school in Regent's Park, part of the University of London. Because it only teaches business, it does not appear in the overall university rankings, yet it ranks 9th in the world for business and management. Its MBA can be finished in 15 to 21 months, and London's position as a global finance and consulting hub shapes recruiting.
description_cn: 伦敦商学院是位于伦敦摄政公园的独立研究生商学院，隶属伦敦大学。它只开设商科，因此不参加大学综合排名，但在 QS 商科排名中位列全球第 9。MBA 可在 15 至 21 个月内完成，伦敦作为全球金融与咨询中心，为学生求职提供了天然优势。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Flexible-length MBA with electives across finance, strategy and entrepreneurship; around 500 students per class from more than 60 countries.
programs_detail.description_cn: 弹性学制 MBA，可选修金融、战略、创业等方向；每届约 500 人，来自 60 多个国家。

programs_detail.name: Masters in Management (MiM)
programs_detail.description_en: Pre-experience management master for recent graduates.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向应届毕业生的管理学硕士，无需工作经验。

programs_detail.name: Masters in Finance (MiF)
programs_detail.description_en: Finance master for professionals with work experience.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向有工作经验人士的金融硕士。

name: Haas School of Business
description_en: Berkeley Haas is the business school of the University of California, Berkeley, and one of the oldest business schools in the United States. Its proximity to Silicon Valley makes technology the largest destination for its MBA graduates, and its culture is defined by four principles, including 'Question the Status Quo'. It also runs a highly selective undergraduate business programme.
description_cn: 伯克利哈斯商学院是加州大学伯克利分校的商学院，也是美国历史最悠久的商学院之一。紧邻硅谷，科技行业是其 MBA 毕业生的第一大去向；学院文化以「质疑现状」等四条原则为核心。本科商科项目同样竞争激烈。

programs_detail.name: Full-time MBA
programs_detail.description_en: About 270 students per class; strong in technology, venture capital and sustainability.
programs_detail.description_cn: 每届约 270 人，科技、风险投资和可持续发展方向突出。

programs_detail.name: Undergraduate BS in Business Administration
programs_detail.description_en: Most students apply to Haas after completing their first two years of study at Berkeley.
programs_detail.description_cn: 大多数学生在伯克利完成前两年学习后申请进入哈斯。

programs_detail.name: Master of Financial Engineering (MFE)
programs_detail.description_en: Quantitative finance master aimed at trading, risk and asset management roles.
programs_detail.description_cn: 定量金融硕士，面向交易、风险管理和资产管理岗位。

name: Johnson Graduate School of Management
programs: Johnson Cornell Tech MBA (1 year, NYC)
description_en: Johnson is Cornell's graduate business school and part of the SC Johnson College of Business. It is known for placing a large share of its MBAs in finance, especially investment banking, and offers a one-year tech-focused MBA at the Cornell Tech campus in New York City in addition to the classic two-year MBA in Ithaca.
description_cn: 约翰逊管理学院是康奈尔大学的研究生商学院，隶属 SC Johnson 商学院。它以金融（尤其是投资银行）就业比例高著称；除伊萨卡的两年制 MBA 外，还在纽约 Cornell Tech 校区开设一年制科技方向 MBA。

programs_detail.name: Two-Year MBA
programs_detail.description_en: About 280 students per class in Ithaca; immersion semesters in finance, consulting and technology.
programs_detail.description_cn: 伊萨卡校区，每届约 280 人，第二学期可选金融、咨询、科技等沉浸式课程。

programs_detail.name: Johnson Cornell Tech MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Accelerated MBA on Roosevelt Island, New York City, built around product and technology work.
programs_detail.description_cn: 位于纽约罗斯福岛的一年制 MBA，围绕产品与科技实践设计。

name: McCombs School of Business
description_en: McCombs is the business school of the University of Texas at Austin. Its accounting programmes are among the strongest in the United States, and Austin's growing tech scene plus Texas's energy industry shape its MBA recruiting. In-state tuition makes it one of the better-value top business schools for Texas residents.
description_cn: 麦库姆斯商学院是德克萨斯大学奥斯汀分校的商学院，会计专业位居全美前列。奥斯汀快速发展的科技产业和德州的能源行业是其 MBA 招聘的重要来源；对德州本地学生而言学费性价比很高。

programs_detail.name: Full-time MBA
programs_detail.description_en: About 235 students per class in Austin.
programs_detail.description_cn: 奥斯汀校区，每届约 235 人。

programs_detail.name: Master in Professional Accounting (MPA)
programs_detail.description_en: Leading accounting master preparing students for the CPA exam and Big Four careers.
programs_detail.description_cn: 顶尖会计硕士，帮助学生准备 CPA 考试并进入四大会计师事务所。

programs_detail.name: BBA
programs_detail.description_en: Undergraduate business degree with majors including accounting, finance and MIS.
programs_detail.description_cn: 本科商科学位，可选会计、金融、信息系统等专业。

name: IESE Business School
description_en: IESE is the graduate business school of the University of Navarra, with main campuses in Barcelona and Madrid and centres in Munich, New York and São Paulo. It is known for case-method teaching and general-management training. The University of Navarra ranks about 279th overall, but 36th for business, almost entirely because of IESE.
description_cn: IESE 是纳瓦拉大学的研究生商学院，主校区位于巴塞罗那和马德里，并在慕尼黑、纽约和圣保罗设有中心，以案例教学和综合管理培养著称。纳瓦拉大学综合排名约第 279，商科却排第 36，几乎全靠 IESE。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: About 420 students per class from more than 50 nationalities; taught through the case method.
programs_detail.description_cn: 每届约 420 人，来自 50 多个国家，以案例教学为主。

programs_detail.name: Master in Management (MiM)
programs_detail.description_en: Pre-experience management master for recent graduates.
programs_detail.description_cn: 面向应届毕业生的管理学硕士。

name: ESSEC Business School
description_en: ESSEC is one of France's leading grandes écoles de commerce, with campuses near Paris (Cergy), in Singapore and in Rabat. It is known for its Master in Management, finance programmes and luxury brand management. As a specialist business school it is not in the overall university rankings.
description_cn: ESSEC 是法国顶尖的高等商学院之一，在巴黎近郊（塞尔吉）、新加坡和拉巴特设有校区，以管理学硕士、金融项目和奢侈品管理闻名。作为专门的商学院，它不参加大学综合排名。

programs_detail.name: Master in Management (Grande École)
programs_detail.description_en: Flagship MiM with a one-year intensive track and a flexible longer track that can include a Singapore term.
programs_detail.description_cn: 旗舰管理学硕士，有一年制强化轨道和可包含新加坡学期的灵活长轨道。

programs_detail.name: Global BBA
programs_detail.description_en: Undergraduate business degree taught in English across ESSEC's campuses.
programs_detail.description_cn: 英文授课的四年制本科商科，可在多个校区学习。

name: ESCP Business School
city: Paris, London, Berlin, Madrid, Turin & Warsaw
description_en: Founded in Paris in 1819, ESCP is often described as the world's oldest business school. It runs one school across six European campuses, and students usually study in two or three countries during a degree. Tuition is the same on every campus.
description_cn: ESCP 于 1819 年创立于巴黎，常被称为全球历史最悠久的商学院。它在欧洲六个城市设有校区，学生在读期间通常会在两到三个国家学习；各校区学费相同。

programs_detail.name: Master in Management (MiM)
programs_detail.description_en: Study across two or three of ESCP's European campuses.
programs_detail.description_cn: 在 ESCP 的两到三个欧洲校区学习。

programs_detail.name: Bachelor in Management (BSc)
programs_detail.description_en: Undergraduate degree studied in three countries, one year each.
programs_detail.description_cn: 本科学位，三年分别在三个国家学习。

name: EGADE Business School
description_en: EGADE is the graduate business school of Tecnológico de Monterrey, one of Latin America's leading private universities. Tec de Monterrey ranks 22nd in the world for business and management, far above its overall rank, and EGADE holds AACSB, EQUIS and AMBA accreditation.
description_cn: EGADE 是蒙特雷科技大学的研究生商学院，后者是拉丁美洲顶尖的私立大学之一。蒙特雷科技大学商科全球第 22，远高于其综合排名；EGADE 拥有 AACSB、EQUIS、AMBA 三重认证。

programs_detail.name: Full-time MBA
programs_detail.description_en: MBA with international residencies; recruiting strongest in technology services, finance and manufacturing.
programs_detail.description_cn: 包含海外驻留学习的 MBA，科技服务、金融和制造业招聘最活跃。

name: Korea University Business School
description_en: Korea University Business School traces its roots to Bosung College, founded in 1905, and is regarded as Korea's first business school. It was the first in Korea to earn AACSB (2005) and EQUIS (2007) accreditation, and it hosts a large number of exchange students each year.
description_cn: 高丽大学商学院可追溯到 1905 年创立的普成专门学校，被视为韩国第一所商学院。它是韩国首家获得 AACSB（2005 年）和 EQUIS（2007 年）认证的商学院，每年接收大量交换生。

programs_detail.name: Undergraduate Business Administration
programs_detail.description_en: Bachelor's degree in business administration on the Anam campus in Seoul.
programs_detail.description_cn: 首尔安岩校区的工商管理本科学位。

programs_detail.name: MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Full-time and part-time MBA programmes.
programs_detail.description_cn: 提供全日制和在职 MBA 项目。

name: PolyU Faculty of Business
description_en: PolyU's Faculty of Business includes the School of Accounting and Finance, the Department of Management and Marketing, and the Department of Logistics and Maritime Studies. Its logistics and shipping expertise reflects Hong Kong's role as a global port, and it offers a broad range of BBA majors and taught master's programmes.
description_cn: 香港理工大学商学院下设会计及金融学院、管理及市场学系、物流及航运学系。依托香港国际港口城市的地位，物流与航运是其特色方向，同时开设多个 BBA 专业和授课型硕士。

programs_detail.name: BBA
programs_detail.description_en: Undergraduate degree with majors such as accounting, finance, marketing and logistics.
programs_detail.description_cn: 本科学位，可选会计、金融、市场营销、物流等专业。

name: Smeal College of Business
description_en: Smeal is Penn State's business school, launched in 1953 and named after Frank and Mary Jean Smeal in 1990. It runs one of the largest undergraduate business programmes in the United States and is particularly well known for supply chain management. Its MBA is a one-year residential programme.
description_cn: 斯米尔商学院是宾州州立大学的商学院，1953 年成立，1990 年以 Frank 和 Mary Jean Smeal 夫妇命名。它拥有全美规模最大的本科商科项目之一，供应链管理尤其知名；MBA 为一年制全日制项目。

programs_detail.name: Undergraduate BS
programs_detail.description_en: Majors include supply chain, finance, accounting, marketing and management.
programs_detail.description_cn: 可选供应链、金融、会计、市场营销、管理等专业。

programs_detail.name: One-Year MBA
programs_detail.description_en: Residential MBA at University Park.
programs_detail.description_cn: 在大学公园校区的一年制全日制 MBA。

name: Luiss University – Business & Management
programs: Bachelor in Management and Computer Science
description_en: Luiss is a private university in Rome focused on economics, business, law and political science. It offers several English-taught bachelor's and master's degrees in business, and its graduate unit, Luiss Business School, runs MBA and executive programmes.
description_cn: Luiss 是位于罗马的私立大学，专注经济、商科、法律和政治学，开设多个英文授课的商科本科和硕士项目；旗下 Luiss 商学院提供 MBA 和高管教育。

programs_detail.name: Bachelor in Economics & Business
programs_detail.description_en: English-taught bachelor's with majors in management, economics and finance.
programs_detail.description_cn: 英文授课本科，可选管理、经济、金融方向。
